shelf-2x1.title: Wall shelf 2x1
shelf-2x1.blurb: Hangs on the wall cleat; its top is a grid of stacking lips, so any 2x1 footprint of crates (or smaller ones, cell by cell) seats exactly as on another crate. Bumper 42 mm below the hook keeps it from tipping forward.
shelf-2x1.print_notes: On its side (an end face on the bed), no supports: the hook, back plate and brace are one constant profile. 4 walls, 25% gyroid. Design load 2 kg.

wall-cleat-2.title: Wall cleat 2 cells
wall-cleat-2.blurb: 45 deg French cleat, 83.5 mm long, 2 countersunk holes for 4 mm wood screws on a 42 mm pitch. Butt strips end to end; shelves slide anywhere along it.
wall-cleat-2.print_notes: Front face (the countersunk side) on the bed, bevel facing up, no supports. 4 walls, 30% infill. Use at least 2 screws with wall anchors.
